test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘DEVOTION’ is written as ‘EHAVREIF’, and ‘SANSKRIT’ is written as ‘TDSZINCL’. How will ‘LICENSED’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/O-8dyIBISvx5o12SRtu7LEU3MrfmUur0K7yvnZtsglByfUu2KE50xGcq6Fq_nOEKo4KE6Pi8qp1t_qIoWZP27wlcEhkexo6SLy4EV_7f2vEMLUJBvfvnqxEzTXkOURl8Qxk2a4F4lUwkwpyJZID43g] 

‘DEVOTION’ is written as ‘EHAVREIF’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22e2e9c9482c305b3acb6cc27690ab2b2b1f9036b3865995e702b496b0ce5c81.png] 

And,

SANSKRIT’ is written as ‘TDSZINCL’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96f029f9f65fe215828b445443bdecba41f73fcdd38aad810cf010718496a610.png] 

Similarly, 

‘LICENSED’ is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/623688ae13e452cabb2a74ccd61cbf10686c2946b6adcb808312fcfa1a5efe02.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MLHLLOYV**".
